title: Self-describing ticket/spec/rule capability catalog (CLI + MCP parity)
command: cargo test -p ticket-api --lib capability_catalog; cargo test -p ticket-cli --test integration_catalog_cli; cargo test -p ticket-mcp --test integration_capabilities_mcp
detail: Verifies one shared catalog lists canonical ticket/spec/rule workflows with required params, nested-root support per workflow, a rule-oriented workflow, and documented parity gaps; the CLI `catalog` command and ticket-MCP `ticket_capabilities` tool emit the same shared catalog so they agree by construction.
